description: PERMANENTLY delete a Klaviyo campaign (a draft, a sent or a cancelled one; a scheduled one must be reverted first). Without confirm:true nothing is deleted and you get the campaign it would delete; call again with confirm:true only after the user says yes. Free. Needs Klaviyo connected (Settings > Connectors > Klaviyo, or connect_connector with a private API key).

confirm.description: true only after the user approved deleting this campaign
